## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. For example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Which SDK package(s) are affected?

Please list the relevant SDK package(s), e.g., `sdk/resourcemanager/compute/armcompute`.

## Additional context

Add any other context, screenshots, or code snippets about the feature request here.

## Are you willing to submit a PR?

- [ ] Yes, I am willing to submit a PR to implement this feature.
